sources.tracking: 求解器几何路径 / Nav2 FollowPath 控制器

actual_map_check.method: 沿整条路径按半个栅格采样，距离变换给出保守净空；未知区与地图外按障碍

metrics.goal_check_basis: last recorded tracking ground-truth sample; XY metres

localization.scope: simulated 2-D lidar + AMCL defaults vs Gazebo truth, paired at estimate source stamps; recorded evidence, not a calibrated localization claim

replans.note: every Nav2 global plan message; replan reasons are not published by the BT and are not inferred

navigation_profile.scope: 仿真低噪声里程计；不适用于实机
navigation_profile.feedback: Gazebo 真值 + odom → map TF；AMCL 仅旁路观测
